name: 16457-longdecode-qwen2vl7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: Qwen2VLForConditionalGeneration: a 28-layer Qwen2 decoder (hidden 3584, 28 query heads, 4 KV heads, head_dim 128, bfloat16, context 32768) with a vision tower in front of it. ~7.6B parameters, ~16 GB of bf16 weights, ungated.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup 10%, no cooldown, bounded at 200 requests with a 2700 s safety cap.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, 128 prompt tokens and 150 output tokens per request, single turn, text only -- no image is ever sent. 200 requests, greedy decoding with `ignore_eos` so exactly 150 decode steps run per request; min and max are pinned equal to the mean on both lengths. vLLM tokenizes the prompt with add_special_tokens=True, so the engine reports 128 plus a token or two.
purpose: A vision-capable 7B assistant answering short text prompts one at a time with long replies on a single GPU.
launch:
# HAZARD: the loader takes flat `key: value` lines only and reads a value beginning `{`
# or `[` as JSON. An indented YAML block never reaches AsyncEngineArgs, so every key here
# must stay on one line.
# HAZARD: this engine version raises TypeError at construction on a key it does not
# define. The keys that are absent from this file are absent on purpose.

model: Qwen/Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct

tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1

# The checkpoint's own torch_dtype, pinned against default drift.
dtype: bfloat16

# The workload's worst case is 128 + 150 = 278 tokens.
max-model-len: 4096

# Written out because V1's default table does not cover the usage context this engine is
# constructed in. Neither can bind at one stream.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 256

enable-prefix-caching: true
enforce-eager: true

# Engine defaults, written out against drift.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
block-size: 16
swap-space: 4
